newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler to announce Detroit investments.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to announce Detroit investments.

text.p: Chrysler Corp Chairman Robert Eaton will announce on Wednesday "significant" new investments in the automaker's local manufacturing facilities, the company said on Tuesday.

Detroit Mayor Dennis Archer and Frank Fountain, vice president of Chrysler's governmental affairs were also scheduled to attend Wednesday's 1000-EDT / 1400 GMT announcement at the company's Mack Avenue Engine Plant.
Chrysler spokesman Dan Moore said the automakr will unveil additional investments at the Mack Avenue facility, as well as its six other Detroit-area plants.
He declined to provide more details.
Chrysler said in 1995 it will spend $750 million to rennovate the existing Mack Avenue plant to build new six- and eight-cylinder engines.

The automaker's other Detroit facilities include the Conner Avenue and Jefferson North assembly operations; the Mound Road and Detroit Axle powertrain plants; the Mount Elliot tool and die facility; and the McGraw Glass operation.
